definitions.full: H7139. qarach I. [ קָרַח ] verb make bald, or a baldness , usually (by mourners) for the dead, compare Rs Semitic i. 306, 2nd ed. 324 (Arabic parallels) (Late Hebrew id. Hiph`il shew baldness ; Arabic wound, make sores , whiteness in face of horse (but be bald , bald ); Ethiopic make bald (rare); Aramaic קְרַח , , chiefly derivatives (and derived Meanings); compare Sinaitic proper name, masculine קרחו קרחה, ; MI 3.21.24.25 proper name, of a location קרחה ); — Qal Imperfect 3masculine plural בְּראִשָׁם קָרְחָה יִקְרְחוּ Lev 21:5 Qr (> Kt יקרחה ; || יְגַלֵּ֑חוּ compare Deut 14:1 ); Imperative feminine singular עַל וָגֹ֫זִּי קָרְחִי Micah 1:16 make a baldness... for. Niph`al Imperfect 3masculine singular לָהֶם יִקָּרֵחַ Jer 16:6 men shall not make themselves bald for them . Hiph`il Perfect 3plural consecutive קָרְחָה אֵלַיִח וְהִקְרִיחוּ Ezek 27:31 and they shall make a baldness (compare Qal> ) for thee . Hoph`al Participle מֻקְרָח כָּלרֿאִשׁ Ezek 29:18 every head made bald (by carrying load).
